app.title: GitHub Stars
app.subtitle: Evaluate any developer based on their public GitHub activity.
app.subtitle2: Get a score from 0 to 100 with fun titles and badges.
app.disclaimer: Only public GitHub data is analyzed. Profiles are computed on the fly and kept in memory for a while. Only when someone presses “Save to Leaderboard” on a profile do we store that profile's username, avatar, name, score, title, badges, category scores, trend and dates.
search.label: GitHub username
search.hint: Letters, numbers and single hyphens, 39 characters at most. Example: torvalds
search.error.invalid: That is not a valid GitHub username: use only letters, numbers and single hyphens (not at the start or the end), 39 characters at most.
home.examples.label: Try an example:
home.top.title: Top 5 of the leaderboard
home.top.unavailable: The leaderboard is not available right now. Try again in a moment.
home.privacy.title: What we store, and when
home.privacy.onTheFly: Profiles are computed on the fly from public GitHub data and kept in memory for a while, so repeating a search is faster.
home.privacy.saved: Only if you press “{button}” on a profile do we store that profile's username, avatar, name, score, title, badges, category scores, trend and dates.
error.title: Error
error.network: Could not reach the server. Check your connection and try again.
error.code.not_found.title: User not found
error.code.not_found: GitHub has no user called @{username}. Check the spelling and try again.
error.code.invalid_username: “{username}” is not a valid GitHub username.
error.code.rate_limited: Too many requests from your connection. Wait a moment and try again.
error.code.quota_exhausted: We have used up our GitHub API allowance for now. Please try again in a few minutes.
error.code.busy: Too many evaluations are running right now. Try again in a few seconds.
error.code.upstream: GitHub returned an error. Try again in a moment.
error.code.timeout: GitHub took too long to answer. Try again in a moment.
error.code.config: The service is temporarily unavailable. Please try again later.
error.code.internal: Something went wrong on our side. Please try again later.
notFound.title: Page not found
notFound.text: This address does not exist. You can search for a GitHub user from the home page or browse the leaderboard.
results.staleNotice: GitHub is not answering right now: this is a saved copy from {date}.
loading.detail: Fetching profile, repositories, commits, PRs, issues...
loading.detail2: This may take a few seconds depending on API limits.
results.disclaimer: Scores are based on public GitHub data only. Private repos, enterprise work, and other contributions are not reflected. This is for fun, not hiring decisions.
